title: Let krn deliver find the PR worktree from the main checkout
body:
Outcome: `krn deliver --pr N` run from the main checkout resolves the PR head's worktree (git worktree list, branch = PR head ref) and binds there, or refuses naming the expected path; the lead skill states where deliver runs.
Evidence: PR #163 first `krn deliver --dry-run` from the main checkout exited 71 "bind: local HEAD differs from PR head"; krn-lead step 8 does not say to run it from the PR worktree, while the CLI help says to resume from the main checkout after retirement.
Proof: deliver bind unit test with an injected worktree list: main checkout plus matching worktree binds; no matching worktree exits 71 naming the branch.
